{{Quote|General Kenobi, our cannons are being destroyed.|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Able-472]] reporting to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 8">{{CW|8}}</ref>}}
'''IG lancer combat droids''', also known as '''IG-series battle droids''' or simply '''IG lancer droids''', were a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The IG Lancer Droid first appeared in combat during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].

==Design==
[[File:IG_Lancer_Droid.jpg|thumb|left|100px|An IG lancer [[Droid/Legends|droid]] on a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]].]]
These tall, thin battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were created to resemble their [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] creators. They were also more advanced than the standard [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. They were armed with giant [[Power lance|energy lances]] and anti-vehicle mines and rode into battle on [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]].<ref name="NEGD" />

They were developed by [[Phlut Design Systems/Legends|Phlut Design Systems]], a [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]-based weapons development firm that took out a large capital investment loan from the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to fund a secret battle droid program that it planned to sell to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. When PDS was unable to repay the InterGalactic Banking Clan, the IBC responded by seizing the assets of the company and adding the battle droids to the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. As an InterGalactic Banking Clan asset, the new droids were renamed the IG-series.<ref name="NEGD" />

After the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassination]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] by the newly anointed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] the droids were deactivated but not destroyed. The [[Phlut Design Systems/Legends|Phlut Design Systems]] kept the blueprints and a few droids. The droids looked very similar in appearance as their later cousins, [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] and [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]], without the shoulder armor protrusions and lack of heavily modified torso armor. Using the blueprints and droid bodies as a basis, The Holowan Technology company, with a contract from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and [[Phlut Design Systems/Legends|Phlut Design Systems]] built and created the infamous [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] and the more infamous IG-88 series droids.

==History==
[[File:Iglancerdroid.jpg|thumb|right|150px|An IG lancer in action on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].]]
IG lancer droids were led by [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] at the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]. They proved a match to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Clone lancer trooper|lancer troopers]] and destroyed nearly all the [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHAs]] during the battle. Some were also deployed during the [[Battle of Amaltanna/Legends|Battle of Amaltanna]], but were mostly destroyed,
